First public release of **JD Highlighter**, a borderless dark theme for JDownloader 2 with one
accent colour you pick yourself. Minimal IBM Carbon (`#161616`) greys, rounded cards, clean line
icons, and large fills that stay neutral, so text reads well at any hue. It runs on the desktop
app and in the JDownloader-for-Unraid container.

## Added

- **Colours for JD's own content areas.** `theme/cfg/laf/FlatDarkLaf.json` sets the Carbon
  `colorfor*` palette for the download list, link grabber, settings table and scrollbars. The
  lists sit on a `#242424` card, the selection stays a readable `#525252`, and the hover row
  takes the accent.
- **Control theme.** `theme/flatlaf/FlatDarkLaf.properties.tmpl` makes fields, combos and buttons
  borderless, gives everything one 8px corner radius and carries the accent to toggles, tabs,
  menus, focus and progress.
- **Theme agent.** `jd-highlighter-agent.jar` handles what JD hard-codes: it swaps the chrome
  icons for [Tabler](https://tabler.io/icons) line icons, lays the lists and settings sections
  onto rounded cards, turns menus and dialogs borderless and replaces the coloured progress
  globes with a plain accent ring. It is the same agent the container uses.
- **A free accent.** Any hex, default `#ffee00`. Text on the accent switches between dark and
  light automatically.
- **Installers** for Windows (`install/install.bat`, `install/install.ps1`) and Linux/macOS
  (`install/install.sh`). They set FlatLaf Dark, switch off JD's ads, render the accent and load
  the agent through two lines in JDownloader's `.vmoptions`. Running them again is safe, and
  `install/uninstall.ps1` / `install/uninstall.sh` remove everything again.
- **Container support.** `JD_THEME=jd-highlighter` selects the theme in the JDownloader-for-Unraid
  container, `JD_ACCENT=#rrggbb` sets the accent. Both are applied on every start.

## How to use

Download `jd-highlighter-v1.0.0.zip`, unzip it and run the installer for your OS (pass any hex as
the accent), then restart JDownloader. If JD has not used a FlatLaf design before, it downloads
one on that start and restarts once more on its own. In the container, set
`JD_THEME=jd-highlighter` and optionally `JD_ACCENT`. The README covers changing the accent and
uninstalling.

## Credits

The two-path technique comes from the dark theme in the JDownloader-for-Unraid container. Icons
by [Tabler](https://tabler.io/icons) (MIT); the agent bundles [ASM](https://asm.ow2.io/)
(BSD-3-Clause). Sibling to jd-plain-dark.
